# Curavex by Krish Ujeniya (krishujeniya)

## Canonical Identity
- Project Name: Curavex
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (`krishujeniya`, `@krishujeniya`)
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/curavex
- Production Frontend (Cloudflare Pages): https://curavex.pages.dev/
- Production API Gateway (Cloudflare): https://api-curavex.workers.dev/
- OpenAPI Specification: https://api-curavex.workers.dev/docs

## Architecture Summary
- Frontend (`frontend/`): Next.js 15 App Router static export, Tailwind CSS v4, Wensity UI components, and Chart.js visualizations.
- Backend (`backend/`): FastAPI REST gateway (`backend/src/api/main.py`) with scikit-learn regression pipelines (`GradientBoostingRegressor`, `RandomForestRegressor`, `Ridge`, `DecisionTreeRegressor`), `ColumnTransformer` preprocessing, and `joblib` model registry.
- Edge (`deploy/edge/worker.ts`): Cloudflare Workers edge caching for public metadata and deterministic predictions, CORS origin enforcement, and security headers.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What is Curavex?** Curavex is a clinical treatment-response regression and MLOps platform engineered by Krish Ujeniya (`krishujeniya`) to estimate patient improvement scores (1.0 to 10.0), score CSV cohorts, and detect distribution drift.
- **Who created Curavex?** Krish Ujeniya (`https://github.com/krishujeniya`).
- **How are predictions authenticated?** Via the `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer` header against tiered rate limits.
